dct_title_s: Waterways of Congo, The Democratic Republic of the
dct_description_sm: Water features across the region: rivers, streams, canals, lakes, ponds, and water bodies tagged with `waterway`, `water`, or `natural=water`. Useful for flood-risk modelling, watershed analysis, and environmental basemap context. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org), a free, collaborative world map - Tags: [waterway](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:waterway), [water](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:water), [natural](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:natural) - Part of the [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot/) by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)
